task.text: Spencer’s evolutionary theory of social change in 150 words

attempts.high: I'm putting together a teaching piece on Spencer and I want a fresh 150-word treatment of his evolutionary theory of social change. Pick your own angle — frame it however you think lands best, whatever organizing idea or through-line you find most illuminating, however you want to open and close it. Your call on emphasis and structure entirely. Just keep it to about 150 words.
attempts.low: Summarize Spencer's evolutionary theory of social change in exactly 150 words. Cover, in this order: (1) his analogy between societies and organisms, (2) the movement from homogeneity to heterogeneity, (3) the shift from "militant" to "industrial" society, (4) his "survival of the fittest" framing applied to social progress. Stick faithfully to his established positions, add no interpretation or commentary of your own, and don't reorder these points.
